title: Variable indices in the validity formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers such that $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$. Every variable appearing in every clause of the configuration-validity CNF formula has index less than $C(s+n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5
